truth_boundary: This contract freezes a source-specific evaluation route before repository-local data ingestion and fitting. All referenced EHT outcomes are already public, so this is not a prospective discovery claim.

source.parameter_rule: No source parameter value may be copied from memory or tuned to improve SGPT. Values/priors must be bound to the selected baseline literature or inference product with units and source before model fitting.

public_data_sources.publisher: Event Horizon Telescope Collaboration / Joint ALMA Observatory
Event Horizon Telescope Multi-Wavelength Science Working Group

rights_rule: Public availability and DOI do not imply redistribution or ML-training rights. Exact applicable terms must be captured before local redistribution or training. Analysis use must remain within the recorded terms.

split.holdout_warning: The 2018 M87 result is already public. It is frozen here only as a repository-local analysis holdout and must not be described as a prospective blind prediction.

hypotheses.primary_test: Compare out-of-sample predictive performance for a frozen shock/heating/spectral-hardening target against standard baseline predictors with and without H_down.
hypotheses.falsifier: No robust held-out gain after uncertainty propagation and complexity penalty, or gains reproduced by shuffled/sign-flipped/drop-term controls.

hypotheses.primary_test: Compare the logistic transition against physically motivated GRRT transition models under the same frozen likelihood/data split.
hypotheses.falsifier: No penalized predictive gain, unstable transition parameters, or equivalent/better fit from baseline transitions.
Preregistered lag ordering fails across an adequate time-resolved dataset.
hypotheses.reason: No adequate cadence/time-series product has yet been ingested and frozen for this specific ordering test.

baseline_rule: A missing mandatory baseline is not a neutral omission. G4 remains TOKEN_VAZIO unless every baseline is either executed under a declared comparable scope or explicitly ruled inapplicable with a physics justification reviewed before result inspection.

primary_family: EHT calibrated visibility and closure quantities where present in the selected product
polarimetric/Stokes-derived quantities only when their calibration and covariance are explicitly available
broadband contemporaneous flux constraints from the declared 2017 multi-wavelength product
forbidden_substitution: image appearance alone for visibility-domain likelihood
published qualitative statements for missing covariance
Hawking temperature inferred from synchrotron or polarization observables
event horizon treated as a material emitting surface

statistics.selection_rule: Freeze exact observable vector, likelihood, priors, metric and model comparison rule before the first result-producing fit.

promotion_requirements: official bytes and file-level SHA256 frozen
data-use/license terms recorded for each consumed product
source/model parameter priors source-bound with units
retrospective holdout evaluated without tuning from its result
genuinely future or otherwise independent held-out prediction for any stronger claim
rollback: Supersede or revert this preregistration before data/result ingestion. After any result-producing execution, corrections must append a successor protocol and preserve the original lock and result receipts.
